name: Vortex
desc: You're falling through a collapsing dimension: run along the inside of a rotating tunnel, dodge obstacles and collect energy fragments while the tunnel twists, turns and finally breaks apart — faster every level. The glitchy, flickering blocks reverse your left and right for a few seconds; the screen turns green and tears while you're reversed. An original Arcade Phantasm game; pure HTML5, no dependencies.
controls: Left/Right or A/D run around the tunnel, Space/Up/W jump, P/Esc pause, M mute, Space/Enter to run again after game over
creator: CursedPrograms
